chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from Al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, that he said:
Every wealth with which you trade, upon you is the Zakat regarding it when the year passes by over it.
Yunus said, The interpretation of that is that everything which is worked for trade from animals and other than them, upon him is the Zakat regarding it.
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on Zakat for goods bought for trade?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the scope of Zakat on trade goods (mal al-tijarah), establishing that the obligation applies to any asset acquired with the intent of commerce, including livestock and merchandise, once a lunar year (hawl) has passed. Yunus ibn Abi al-‘Imran’s interpretation underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on the underlying purpose (niyyah) of acquisition in determining Zakat liability, distinguishing commercial assets from personal use. This ruling is foundational in Ja’fari jurisprudence for calculating Zakat on diverse modern and historical trade inventories.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ismail Bin Marrar, from Yunus, from Al A;ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim,
‘Heasws said: ‘Every wealth worked with, so upon you is the Zakāt with regards to it, when the year passes by over it’.
Yunus said, ‘The interpretation of that is that everything what is worked with for the business from the animals and other such, so upon him is the Zakāt with regards to it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ’Isma‘il ibn Marrar from Yunus from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Any asset with which you work is subject to Zakat when one year passes.’
Yunus has said that the explanation for it is that whatever asset is used in business, animals or other assets, it is subject to Zakat.”
